text:
The cargo crew mentioned something about water breaks, and many thanks for your thoughts. We are sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk left you worried and frustrated. You explained that your companion animal's travel was disrupted, your plans were thrown off, and the handling felt far below the care you expected.

Safety always comes before speed in every journey, and we regret that this did not feel true in your case. Our ground team is expected to move carriers carefully between services and to give clear guidance before departure so travelers can prepare with confidence. When a missed connection happens, <<FACT F110>>. That standard should help reduce the strain of a disrupted trip, but we understand that compensation alone does not remove the stress you experienced.

We also understand your concern about the crate and the delay in resolving what happened. If a crate is lost, <<FACT F118>>. We know this process matters because it gives families a clear path to report the issue and seek support without unnecessary confusion. Even so, we are sorry that you had to push for answers during an already difficult time.

Your comments have been shared with the teams involved so they can review handling, communication, and follow-up more closely. We are also asking the welcome team and ground staff to reinforce careful transfer checks and clearer passenger updates before boarding. We want every traveler, including those with companion animals, to feel that their pet is treated with steady care and respect throughout the trip.

Thank you for taking the time to write. We are sorry for the disruption and will continue working to make future journeys calmer and more reliable.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
